stories.title: PayPal users warned over 1p deposit scam that triggers fake phone calls
stories.summary: PayPal users are being warned to be on their guard after scammers found a way to trigger genuine emails from the platform as part of a phone fraud. stories.title: NSPCC Cymru seeks 12 to 15-year-olds in Wales to join online safety panel
stories.summary: Young people aged 12 to 15 in Wales are being invited to apply to join an NSPCC panel that advises politicians, regulators and tech companies on online safety. NSPCC Cymru is recruiting for the charity’s Voice of Online Youth group, which campaigns to make the internet safer for children. Up to 20 places are available

stories.title: HMRC warns of Winter Fuel Payment scams as recovery process begins in April
stories.summary: HMRC is warning pensioners to be on guard against scams as the recovery of Winter Fuel Payments from those with annual income above £35,000 begins this month.
